prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished wide landscape website product-card artwork for Message Sets, a Discord bot feature for saving reusable designed message sets, posting a selected set into a channel, and updating an existing bot message with the latest saved design.
Input image: supplied Review Credit artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Match the exact same white ceramic floating bot head, glossy obsidian face with two softly glowing blurple rounded-square eyes, circular refractive lavender glass platform, prominent correct white Discord Clyde logo on round blurple enamel badge centered on front of platform, tiny green status LED, pearl-white studio, three-quarter camera angle, refined soft lighting, realistic materials and scale. Completely replace review-related objects.
Primary request: beautiful premium 3D artwork communicating a collection of reusable beautifully designed Discord message templates ready to send. NO written text.
Subject/composition: familiar friendly bot head floats center-right, looking toward the feature objects on center-left. Main feature object to center-left is a fan of THREE substantial floating rounded-rectangle MESSAGE DESIGN CARDS, staggered in depth like an elegantly organized reusable template library, distinctly three separate cards. Each card has a pearl-white ceramic body and precise lavender-glass beveled rim. The front card is dominant and fully readable in silhouette: a tiny raised lavender landscape image pictogram near its top with two mountain triangles and circular sun, a few broad blank rounded geometric content blocks beneath it, and TWO small empty pill-shaped component pieces in a single row along bottom, one blurple and one mint. These are physical abstract template parts, not text or a real app screenshot. The other two cards behind display complementary abstract geometric layout arrangements with subtle lilac and pale-blue accents, partially visible and clearly a coordinated set. A small beautifully sculpted white paper-airplane SEND pictogram with a satin blurple trailing edge floats diagonally forward of the cards near lower center-left, suggesting posting a chosen set. One restrained thin lavender glass swoosh connects the card stack toward the bot, keep it subtle and uncluttered. Cards must be differentiated from bank cards: no chip, no magnetic strip, no payment elements.
Platform: shared circular lavender translucent glass plinth, correct highly recognizable white Discord Clyde emblem on circular Discord-blurple badge centered on front face, two round eye cutouts; small green status LED beside emblem. Keep bot face and badge unobscured.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product campaign illustration, realistic tactile white porcelain, satin Discord blurple #5865F2, softly brushed silver accents, precise refractive lavender glass, delicate pale-blue and mint secondary colors. Broad softbox light from upper left, gentle lilac rim illumination, controlled highlights, subtle realistic ray-traced shadows, seamless near-white to very pale lavender studio and softly reflective matte floor. Charming, sophisticated, professional, strong thumbnail-readable silhouette.
Framing: wide 16:9 around 1672x941 or higher; balanced centered sculptural still life, cards left and bot right above the shared plinth, all essential objects fully visible inside central 80% with generous margins. Quiet upper-left corner for website overlay. Consistent with reference series, no typography column.
Constraints: one bot, exactly three template cards, one send pictogram, one platform, one Discord badge. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, words, SET labels, written commands, pseudo-text, logos other than Discord, watermark, real UI screenshot or outer card frame. Abstract blank shapes only on message cards. No review hearts, stars, checks, lightning bolts, headphones, wallets, coins, credit card chips, banknotes, QR codes, shop storefront, pencils, magnifiers, server hardware, hands, people or robot limbs. No clutter, excessive neon or dark cyberpunk. Render finished artwork itself, not a website mockup.
